'''2001 KublaCon tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG casual held at KublaCon, Oakland, California on 26 May 2001. It is known from Nick Stefanko's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2378">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-27-kublacon-5-27-01d2378/ kublacon-5-27-01], DeckTech (Nick "JediBrain" Stefanko, 27 May 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-27-kublacon-5-27-01d2378/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 26 May 2001
* '''Site:''' KublaCon, Oakland, California
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 2
